input.summary: Plunge B, O, then N; use the outer deflector from the left flipper, then use the right flipper to raise and collect the saucer value.

quickInfo.name: B-O-N skill shot
quickInfo.summary: Collect B before O and N because a missed top-lane plunge usually rattles rightward.

quickInfo.name: Saucer value
quickInfo.summary: The center spinner changes the left saucer value between 1,000 and 5,000.

quickInfo.name: Captive ball
quickInfo.summary: The captive ball scores 1,000 to 4,000 by depth and another 3,000 at its rear standup.

quickInfo.name: Outer deflector
quickInfo.summary: The far-right outer arc can score 5,000, return through the 3,000 plunger lane, and provide another top plunge.

quickInfo.name: Letter trio target
quickInfo.summary: The top-right target awards missing letters from the currently lit BON, VOY, or AGE trio.

steps.text: Plunge B first, then collect O and N on later top-lane plunges.
From the left flipper, shoot the far-right outer deflector arc.
Let the returning ball enter the plunger lane, then plunge another missing top letter.
From the right flipper, read the current left-saucer value.
At 1,000 or 2,000, shoot the center spinner to change the value.
At 3,000, 4,000, or 5,000, shoot the left saucer.
Use the top-right target to collect missing letters from its lit trio.
When all nine letters are complete, stop shooting the captive ball unless Special has value.

fallback.title: Spinner-to-saucer cycle
fallback.when: Use this plan when the outer deflector route does not return the ball to the plunger lane reliably.

steps.text: Control the ball on the right flipper.
Shoot the spinner while the saucer shows 1,000 or 2,000.
Read the new saucer value before the next shot.
Shoot the saucer when it shows at least 3,000.
Repeat while the spinner and saucer returns remain controlled.

alternatives.title: Early captive-ball scoring
alternatives.when: Use this plan before all nine letters are complete and when the captive-ball rebound is safe.

steps.text: Confirm that at least one BON VOYAGE letter is still missing.
Shoot the captive ball with enough force to cross both chute switches.
Reach the rear standup only when the stronger hit remains safe.
Stop all captive-ball shots after the ninth letter lights.
Collect B, O, and N from top plunges.
Use the top-right target for missing BON, VOY, or AGE letters.
Carry completed letters across balls.
Complete all nine letters.
Preserve the letter bonus by avoiding the captive-ball Special reset.

techniques.name: B-first plunge
techniques.instruction: Plunge B before O or N. A missed lane usually moves right, which makes later O and N attempts easier.

techniques.name: Outer-deflector loop
techniques.instruction: From the left flipper, shoot the far-right outer arc. Let the return bend guide the ball into the plunger lane.

techniques.name: Saucer-value read
techniques.instruction: Read the saucer lamp before every right-flipper shot. Use the spinner below 3,000 and the saucer at 3,000 or more.

cautions.issue: A captive-ball shot after all nine letters can award a worthless Special and reset the carried bonus.
cautions.response: Check the Special award before play. Stop captive-ball shots after the ninth letter when Special has no value.

cautions.issue: A ball that falls straight through the spinner can drain down the center.
cautions.response: Prepare both flippers before the spinner exit. Stop repeating a spinner feed that returns too straight or too slowly.

cautions.issue: A top exit can reach a slingshot and then the outlane.
cautions.response: Track the ball from the upper playfield. Nudge before it contacts the outside edge of a slingshot.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the single-player 1974 Bally Bon Voyage, ball count, tilt, replay and Special conversion, and whether the event scores points, credits, or both.
Confirm that BON VOY AGE letters carry across balls and a captive-ball Special resets the bonus before using the captive ball after all nine letters light.
Test the spinner stopping position, left-saucer kickout, captive-ball strength, outer-deflector return to the plunger lane, and top-lane and slingshot feeds.

input.simpleOverview: Bon Voyage uses repeated shooter-lane returns to finish B, O, and N, while a center spinner changes the left-saucer value. Shoot the far-right outer deflector from the left flipper for another plunge, then use the right flipper to spin a low saucer value or collect it at 3,000 to 5,000.
